You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. jobs.occupation: Software Stability Expert (f/m/x) (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 192515

At BMW Car IT, a wholly owned subsdiary of BMW AG, we live and breathe software. We design and implement embedded aoftware for electronic control units of the BMW cars as well as related tools and frameworks. By delivering software all the way from the idea to the final product we lead BMW into the future of digitalization and mobility.

What awaits you?

- You ensure system stability for Linux and Android-based embedded platforms across software deliveries.
- You analyse and resolve complex issues related to performance, boot behavior, memory management, CPU load, and system services.
- Furthermore, you debug cross-layer issues across kernel, frameworks, HALs, middleware, drivers, and applications.
- In addition, you perform root cause analysis using tracing, profiling, and debugging tools.
- You examine crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, watchdog resets, and memory leaks to improve system robustness.
- Moreover, you develop proof of concepts, validation solutions, and automation tools for analysis and monitoring.
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability and software quality.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a comparable field.
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Linux and Android embedded systems.
- Extensive experience with Linux kernel, Android framework, system services, boot process, and resource management.
- Advanced knowledge of debugging, tracing, profiling, and performance analysis tools such as GDB, Perf, Ft , Perfetto, ADB, and Logcat.
- Experience in analysing crashes, memory leaks, deadlocks,   conditions, kernel panics, ANRs, and performance bottlenecks.
- Professional experience in embedded software development and quality assurance in the automotive industry.
- Very good business English skills; German language skills are an advantage.

Would you like to improve the stability, reliability, and performance of next-generation automotive platforms in a highly collaborative environment? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer in Ulm?

- Company car option.
- English speaking teams in an intercultural setting.
- Flexible organisation of working times & mobile work arrangements.
- Career development & continuous personal qualification.
- Relocation Services for our new employees.

Earliest starting date: from now on

Working hours: full time

jobs.description: Apply NowProduct Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Cyber Defense OperationsDate: 10/08/2026Company: SAPWe help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.Summary & Role Information:Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.What You'll Do:- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations.
